description: Add a domain to the signed-in user's MailVakt account for DMARC report collection. Takes a domain; returns its DMARC reporting (rua) address and account entry. Repeated calls for the same account and domain return the existing entry. Requires domains:write permission. Does not verify domain ownership, modify DNS, or start receiving reports until the user publishes the reporting address in DNS.

domain.description: The domain to add, e.g. example.com

name: add_domain
title: Add domain
